scope: Independent scratch exact derivation of resonant cylindrical Bernstein raw energy, physical mass, variational eigen-ODE, square lower bound and leading axis coefficients. No product/upstream edits, promotion, Fo lifecycle, rootfinding, or numerical convergence claims.
assumptions: All amplitudes, coefficients and jets are real; explicit native engine real facts.
r>0, a>0, mu0>0, p_edge>0, gamma>0, rho>0, H>0, S>0, lambda<0, Z!=0, m positive integer; explicit native engine facts.
Physical radial domain 0<r<=a; axis treated by regular-limit analysis. Upper bound r<=a is a mathematical domain restriction, not encoded as a native interval fact.
Constant mass density; Btheta=A*r, Bz=Z, pressure=p_edge+A^2*(a^2-r^2)/mu0, resonance k=-m*A/Z.
Physical S=B^2/Z^2 and H=B^2/mu0+gamma*p. These are positive on the physical domain under the stated signs.
Canonical energy functional is taken from the independently cited fixture Bernstein no-gravity expression; the proof starts at that functional and the cylindrical vector calculus.
Rigid conducting wall f(a)=0. No free-boundary or vacuum-interface energy is included.
Real nonzero Fourier harmonics have common angular factor pi*L; eigenvalue is 2 deltaW/N.
Indicial coefficient identities are exact; convergence/existence of a full Frobenius series is not established by zero tests.

proof.suite: Resonant screw-pinch raw energy and radial ODE
